pattern: SELECT .+ FROM Professionals AS p JOIN \( SELECT professional\_id FROM Treatments GROUP BY professional\_id HAVING COUNT\(*\) > \d+ ) AS t ON p.professional\_id = t.professional\_id WHERE p.state = 'Indiana'
correction: SELECT professional_id , last_name , cell_number FROM Professionals WHERE state = 'Indiana' UNION SELECT T1.professional_id , T1.last_name , T1.cell_number FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id GROUP BY T1.professional\_id HAVING count\(*\) > 2

metadata.description: This rule corrects errors where a subquery is used incorrectly in the JOIN clause, instead of joining tables directly.
